description: The owner's V8 preset: a 6.2 L crossplane V8. The owner's own preset, converted faithfully (a race cam at 0.9999, the air at 233 K, the muffler open: on purpose): stock-engine figures are no target of it. Its targets are the contract's and what the preset is meant to do; it has no published figure.

targets.name: Starts and runs
targets.source: a warm engine started on its key runs (engine.state 2)

targets.name: Within full scale
targets.source: 02-contracts.md, section 1: what process writes is within +-1

targets.name: Holds the limiter
targets.source: a fuel-cut rev limiter holds the speed within a few percent of where it cuts

targets.name: Lumpy idle
targets.source: the preset's race cam idles lumpy near 1050 rpm in the plugin it was made in (the owner, through the lead): 950 to 1150 rpm
